scripts.name: Audit-EntraSecurity.ps1
scripts.description: Read-only Microsoft Graph audit of Entra security settings, Conditional Access, legacy authentication controls, named locations, identity risk access, and recent failed sign-ins.

scripts.name: Remediate-EntraSecurity.ps1
scripts.description: Creates a report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all users and checks Smart Lockout settings. Exclude a break-glass account before enabling the policy.

scripts.name: Cleanup-WindowsUpdates.ps1
scripts.description: Resets Windows Update services and cache, runs DISM and SFC, and clears temporary and Prefetch files. Requires administrator rights and makes broad system changes.

scripts.name: Disable-BrowserNotifications.ps1
scripts.description: Changes Edge and Chrome policies to block notifications and pop-ups, edits the Edge profile and hosts file, and enables SmartScreen.

scripts.name: Remove-DellBloatware.ps1
scripts.description: Removes a configured set of Dell apps and utilities. Review the removal list first to keep any Dell tools you still use.

scripts.name: Remove-LenovoBloatware.ps1
scripts.description: Removes Lenovo apps, services, scheduled tasks, and startup entries, with a WhatIf preview option. It preserves hardware and pointing-device drivers.

scripts.name: Remove-Windows10Bloatware.ps1
scripts.description: Removes the Windows 10 apps listed in its configuration. Review that list before running because some listed apps may be ones you want to keep.

scripts.name: The RunMe Bit.cmd
scripts.description: Currently contains a PowerShell execution-policy command despite its .cmd extension; it may not run as a batch file and needs review before use.

scripts.name: Windows11_Cleanup.ps1
scripts.description: Prompts before clearing Windows Update cache, Windows and user temporary files, Prefetch, and update logs, then restarts Windows Update.

scripts.name: CorporateBuild.ps1
scripts.description: Provisions and configures a Windows 11 PC: installs apps and updates, removes selected consumer and OEM software, sets regional preferences, configures Microsoft 365 sign-in, and writes a build report. May prompt to reboot.

scripts.name: Add_Archive_Prefix_SharedMailboxes.ps1
scripts.description: Adds an Archive- prefix to cloud-only shared mailbox display names and reports synced mailboxes that need renaming on-premises.

scripts.name: Convert_SharedMailboxes_CloudManaged.ps1
scripts.description: Changes synced shared mailboxes to cloud-managed Exchange attributes and reports their resulting status.

scripts.name: Enable-DKIM-O365.ps1
scripts.description: Installs or updates the Exchange Online module, checks DKIM DNS records, creates configuration if needed, and enables DKIM signing for a domain.

scripts.name: Enable_Archive_All_Users.ps1
scripts.description: Finds non-shared mailboxes at or above 20 GB without an online archive and enables archiving for them.

scripts.name: ExchangeOnline_DelegatedAccess_Setup.ps1
scripts.description: Sets a user-scoped PowerShell execution policy, installs Exchange Online modules, and connects to a configured customer tenant using delegated access.

scripts.name: Hide_CloudOnly_SharedMailboxes_GAL.ps1
scripts.description: Hides cloud-only shared mailboxes from the Global Address List and lists synced mailboxes for separate on-premises handling.

scripts.name: Hide_Shared_Mailboxes_GAL.ps1
scripts.description: Hides all shared mailboxes from the Global Address List and displays their resulting visibility state.

scripts.name: Initialize-ArchiverEnvironment.ps1
scripts.description: Prepares the SharePoint archiver environment, installs or updates PnP.PowerShell, connects to a site, and can save client connection details for reuse.

scripts.name: Mailboxes_Over50GB_With_ArchiveSize.ps1
scripts.description: Reports mailboxes at least 50 GB in size with mailbox type, archive status, and archive size.

scripts.name: Manage-M365GroupOwners.ps1
scripts.description: Uses an existing Microsoft Graph session to find a Microsoft 365 group and interactively manage its owners.

scripts.name: MergeContacts.ps1
scripts.description: Reads duplicate contact pairs from a CSV and uses Xero API authentication to merge the selected contacts.

scripts.name: Run-QuarterlyArchive.ps1
scripts.description: Runs SharePoint archiving for configured clients, with dry-run and live-run modes and an option to target a single client.

scripts.name: Promote-CurrentUserToLocalAdmin.ps1
scripts.description: Adds the interactively signed-in Entra ID user to the local Administrators group. It must be run from an already elevated session.

scripts.name: Run-PromoteToLocalAdmin.bat
scripts.description: Launcher that requests elevation, unblocks the companion PowerShell script, and runs it with a process-scoped execution-policy bypass.

scripts.name: Configure-DefenderQuiet.ps1
scripts.description: Changes Microsoft Defender settings to reduce alerts and cloud protections, including attempting to disable Tamper Protection. Review carefully because it weakens security protections.

scripts.name: Defender365Fix.ps1
scripts.description: Installs Microsoft 365 and Defender PowerShell modules, connects to the services, and applies Defender-related configuration changes.

scripts.name: Verify-Harmoniq-gMSA.ps1
scripts.description: Checks whether the Harmoniq group Managed Service Account is ready on the local server or configured remote servers.

scripts.name: Archive-StaleSharePointFiles.ps1
scripts.description: Finds stale SharePoint files; dry-run is the default. A live run copies and verifies files before deleting originals or moving them to a pending-delete folder.

scripts.name: Clear-OneDriveCrash.ps1
scripts.description: Stops OneDrive and clears local cache and sync database files to help recover from crashes or sync issues.

scripts.name: Get-AllClientSharePointSites.ps1
scripts.description: Uses Partner Center and delegated access to enumerate customer SharePoint sites and export site details to CSV.

scripts.name: Get-OneDriveSyncStatus.ps1
scripts.description: Checks OneDrive process and sync database status and can report on large SharePoint sites to help diagnose sync issues.

scripts.name: Remove-OneDriveApps.ps1
scripts.description: Uninstalls OneDrive applications and related components from Windows; run elevated for full effect.

scripts.name: Archive-SharePointFiles.ps1
scripts.description: Copies older SharePoint files into a dedicated archive site, verifies each copy, and only deletes originals when configuration enables a live run.

scripts.name: Archive-ToM365ColdStorage.ps1
scripts.description: Archives older SharePoint files to Microsoft 365 cold storage through Microsoft Graph while keeping their library location and permissions.

scripts.name: Manage-ArchiveProfiles.ps1
scripts.description: Interactive wizard for client archive profiles and app/certificate records; it can register apps and create, export, or delete certificates.

scripts.name: Remove-EmptyFolders.ps1
scripts.description: Finds empty SharePoint folders left after archiving; previews by default and sends removed folders to the site recycle bin when executed.

scripts.name: Rename-ProblemFiles.ps1
scripts.description: Finds file and folder names likely to break SharePoint copy or sync operations; previews proposed renames by default and applies them only with Execute.

scripts.name: Verify-ArchiveReconciliation.ps1
scripts.description: Read-only comparison of source and archive libraries that identifies archived, copied-but-not-deleted, and not-yet-archived files.

scripts.name: Fix-ModulePaths.ps1
scripts.description: Reinstalls PowerShell modules found under a OneDrive-redirected path into the system-wide module location, then removes the OneDrive copies.

scripts.name: Fix-SpellCheck-Win10.ps1
scripts.description: Clears Windows 10 spell-check caches and restores spell-check settings changed by privacy or app-removal tools.

scripts.name: Fix-SpellCheck.ps1
scripts.description: Clears Windows 11 spell-check caches and restores spell-check settings changed by privacy or app-removal tools.

scripts.name: Reset-Teams.ps1
scripts.description: Stops Teams, uninstalls available Teams versions, and removes Teams cache, local data, and registry leftovers to prepare for a fresh install.

scripts.name: ResetCreds.ps1
scripts.description: Lists matching Adobe and Microsoft credentials for the current Windows user and deletes them after confirmation; supports preview mode.

scripts.name: DuplicateFinder.ps1
scripts.description: Queries Xero for active customers, identifies likely duplicate pairs, and writes them to CSV. The public source contains an apparent hard-coded Xero client secret; rotate it and review the script before use.

scripts.name: youtube_transcript_downloader.py
scripts.description: Downloads transcripts for YouTube video or playlist URLs and saves one text file per video.
